history.summary: Polished 5 woodland ley/shadow spells with distinct healing/ward/chill/damage scaling and removed sourcebook tags from descriptions.
Polished Jagged Forcelance, Lance of the Sun God, Outmaneuver, Hematomancy, and Converse with Dragon with thematic damage/healing/undead/evasion synergy and removed sourcebook tags.

Polished Protection from the Void (+Shield 2t), Shackle (+Chill 1t), Freezing Fog (+Chill 2t & Evade 1t), Beguiling Bet (+Evade 2t), and Starburst (+1 bonus & 2x vs Undead), removing all sourcebook tags.

Fixed Snow Fort from fire to frost (+Shield 2t & Chill 1t), polished Keening Wail (+2 bonus & Chill 2t), Sun's Bounty (+OOC healing), Ambusher's Regret (+1d8 force rebuke), and Jedza's Tidy Charm (+OOC 1d6 heal & Shield 1t), removing all sourcebook tags.
